[SWS_DM_01988] Unexpected monitor action handling
⌈
If ara::diag::Moni-
tor::ReportMonitorAction is called with a parameter "action" value that is not
supported by the used debouncing method as per the [SWS_DM_01987], the DM shall
trigger a violation according to [SWS_CORE_00003] in the process of the correspond-
ing ara::diag::Monitor interface.
⌋
